collection.title: Honda Civic Aerodeck 1998 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Honda Civic Aerodeck 1998 to 2001 model requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18"  on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this Civic Aerodeck, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
